holdout_claim: NONE. No partition supports a holdout claim.

disclosures.what: One developer wrote the 100 synthetic records, the research rules, the mock policies, the variant generator and the scoring.
disclosures.effect: No partition is a holdout. Evaluation results are a conformance check of the rules against their author’s own construction intent.

disclosures.what: D13: an identifier-prefix list was written partly from memory of evaluation records (WO, INC from F05 and F08).
disclosures.effect: Removed before any scored run and replaced by a general rule. The remaining lexicons were still written by the author of the evaluation records.

disclosures.what: The rule-aligned mock generator ran research-profile functions (sentenceUnits, researchEvents) on evaluation texts while building mocks before the freeze.
disclosures.effect: Outputs were written to mock files and not inspected. No rule changed after that generation. Aggregate counts of changed mock files (M5) were seen.

disclosures.what: ORACLE mocks are told each record’s reference label; ORACLE-R and OVERCLAIM-R quote with the rules under test.
disclosures.effect: Mock-arm agreement is partly circular. It shows what the rules do with a given proposal; it says nothing about how a model would propose.

disclosures.what: The variant generator’s decision patterns were adjusted after dry checks on development records.
disclosures.effect: Evaluation variants use patterns tuned on development texts; constructibility on evaluation records was seen only as counts.

disclosures.what: The 24 originals are public, were shown to earlier study participants, and were read by three LLM raters and by the developer.
disclosures.effect: Prior exposure is high; the originals cannot serve as unseen material.

disclosures.what: Variant expected relations and mock fixes M4 and M5 were set after development-partition variant runs (vdev-1 to vdev-3).
disclosures.effect: Disclosed in DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md; evaluation-partition variants were not run before the freeze.

disclosures.what: No human has reviewed any reference label used in scoring.
disclosures.effect: Every agreement figure is against an AI-authored or LLM-reproduced reference.
